paragraphs.source_en: *Marla:* Actually, we’ve been struggling with this issue for some time. The rates for coverage have been increasing about 15 percent annually for the last five years. We already have a lot of pressure to attract and maintain a quality workforce. Granted, an eighteen-year-old may not care about insurance coverage because he thinks he is superman. But the average age of our workforce is twenty-seven and most of our guys have families. Therefore, health-care coverage is a necessity. In fact, we’ve tried cheaper plans and they did not work. We have found this subject coming up in our exit interviews when employees leave our company. We discovered that talented people were leaving because our competitors offered better plans.
